title: THE MOST EXTREME PLACES ON EARTH
hook: These are the most extreme places on planet Earth.

items.say: The hottest temperature ever recorded: 134 degrees, in Death Valley, USA.
items.label: Death Valley

items.say: The coldest town on Earth: Oymyakon, Russia. Minus 90 degrees.
items.label: Oymyakon

items.say: The coldest temperature ever: minus 128 degrees, at Vostok Station, Antarctica.
items.label: Vostok Station

items.say: The wettest place on Earth: Mawsynram, India.
items.label: Mawsynram

items.say: The driest: the Atacama Desert, in Chile.
items.label: Atacama Desert

items.say: The highest point: Mount Everest, 29,032 feet.
items.label: Mount Everest

items.say: The lowest land: the Dead Sea, more than 1,400 feet below sea level.
items.label: Dead Sea

items.say: And the deepest point: the Mariana Trench, almost 36,000 feet deep.
items.label: Mariana Trench
